body.description: Pixel-art diorama: an intimate lived-in refuge at a dungeon entrance. Broad connected color clusters, compact heroic silhouettes, matte planes, crisp stepped edges, quiet shadow masses and selective details. 8-12 varied mercenaries talk in pairs, share bowls and mend equipment, amid bedrolls, patched cloth and sacks. Exactly ONE small mage stands apart, STRICTLY BACK TO CAMERA, entirely in deep architectural shadow. Opaque black hood and cloak conceal face, skin, hands, hair, age and gender; no rim light. Nobody notices, looks toward or reacts to the mage. Social warmth belongs to others; the mage is excluded from their connections. No war, army, battlefield, ruined city, monsters, epic scale, magic glow, grain, dithering, text, icons or HUD. PLACE: A dormant small charcoal kiln with low stone dome, timber lean-to and ash chute reused as a refuge. People share a pot and clean gear; bedding under dry eaves. Dark maintenance tunnel reaches dungeon. No forge or factory. COMPOSITION: Overhead roof cutaway, curved dome dominates and tiny bed pockets hug its asymmetrical base. COLOR SCRIPT: chalk bone stone, ink blue shadows, ash brown wood, tiny dull gold accents. Restrained saturation, a legible dark mage silhouette. One complete scene with a quiet dark surrounding field, no decorative frame.
